description: DALI registry and driver settings (Opta 4.8.6+; saved automatically). action: bind (ep, pca_id 2001.. or 0), settings (ep, any of fade_time 0..15, fade_rate 0..15, power_on, system_failure, min, max 0..254, curve 0 log / 1 linear; write=true (default) sends them to the driver), groups (ep, group 0..15, member true|false), read (ep: read the driver), identify (ep), add (panel, address 0..63 short / 64..79 group / 80 broadcast), add_all (panel: everything the last scan found), delete (ep), pool (lo, hi PCA ids), auto_bind, scan (panel: find drivers on the bus), abort (panel), commission (panel, mode 0 = re-address ALL / 1 = only unaddressed, start 0..63 - admin), short_address (ep, new 0..63 - admin), reset (ep - admin), panel_config (panel, field 0..6, value). Editor/admin level.
name: myio_dali_set
title: Configure DALI
